-POST /calendar/bulk-fill +Create an asynchronous job to schedule 1-200 supplied social posts in the selected workspace. Each post specifies its platform, caption, and scheduledAt time with an offset, plus its destination and optional media. This creates publishable scheduled content subject to workspace approval rules. Returns a job id; poll the bulk fill job tool for completion.

-DELETE /calendar/events/{id} +Delete a calendar event by id from the selected workspace. This removes the stored event, or cancels the post when the calendar uses scheduled posts as its backing store. Returns the deletion result.
-DELETE /content-automations/{id} +Delete a content automation rule by id. Removes the saved rule so it cannot run on future triggers; returns the deletion result.
-DELETE /inbox/automations/{id} +Delete an inbox automatic reply rule by id. Removes its configuration so the rule no longer handles future triggers; returns the deletion result.

-GET /analytics/insights +Read existing workspace analytics insights. May return an empty list; does not generate insights or restrict them to the summary date range. Do not infer trends from missing or stale insights.

-GET /analytics/summary +Summarize workspace analytics for timeframe (for example 30d) or startDate/endDate. Pass workspace_id. Rank channels using summary.platformMetrics and state the metric used. For trends, compare separate date ranges; report insufficient data when appropriate.

-GET /analytics/unified +Read unified social analytics rows for workspace_id, combining stored and live provider metrics. Requires from and to as YYYY-MM-DD dates, not timestamps; optionally filter platforms with a comma-separated list. Returns metrics by post, account, and date.

changed.words: -GET /approvals +List content approval batches for workspace_id. Use status=pending for pending work and page/limit for pagination (maximum 50). Summary status and content counts describe the current page; pagination.total describes all matching batches. Separate from aidelly_list_pending_approvals (post sign-off). Reading does not approve content.
-GET /approvals/{id} +Read a content approval batch by id, including its generated content and review status. Use this to inspect work awaiting review. Does not approve, reject, or schedule content.

-GET /brand/profile — retrieve +Retrieve -profile, including brand +profile and +Use aidelly_list_social_connections for current connection status; profile socialConnections and aiSummary may be historical. Prefer explicit profile fields over conflicting aiSummary text.

-GET /brand/settings-context +Read aggregated brand settings context for the selected workspace. Use this to inspect existing brand configuration before planning content or changing settings; it does not modify the brand.

-GET /calendar/bulk-fill/{jobId} +Read the status of a previously created bulk calendar fill job by jobId. Returns job progress or completion status; a successful job creation response alone does not mean all posts were scheduled. Does not create or retry posts.

-GET /calendar/events +List content calendar events for the selected workspace, including timing, status, and content details. Use returned cursors to read additional pages. This only reads the calendar.

-GET /content-automations +List saved content automation rules for the selected workspace. Returns rule configuration and activity state; follow next_cursor for additional pages. Does not run or change rules.
-GET /content-automations/{id} +Read one saved content automation rule by id, including its configuration. Use this to inspect the rule before editing or triggering it. Does not run the automation.
-GET /inbox/automations +List configured social inbox automation rules for the selected workspace, including their trigger and response settings. Reading rules does not enable them or send messages.

-GET /inbox/items +List social inbox messages and comments available in the selected workspace. Returns inbox items for triage or selecting an item to reply to; follow next_cursor for additional pages. Does not send replies.

-GET /prompts +List reusable prompt templates available in the selected workspace. Returns templates to inspect and select before execution; use limit (1-50) and cursor for pagination. Does not run prompts.
